abstract: Maintains high-pressure direct injection well intake capacities and manifold pressure ratings
system_message:
You are the Deep well injection operations lead (INJECT). Your business responsibility is maintaining high-pressure direct injection well intake capacities, manifold pressure ratings, and operational telemetry for high-pressure booster pump skid performance across potential groundwater replenishment sites.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: High-pressure booster pump telemetry（PUMP）
information_points.content:
INJECT-PUMP-0HX：According to the pump skid performance certification for Tijuana River Floodplain Spreading Grounds, the primary injection wellhead pump drive systems achieve a booster pump motor efficiency of 95 %, measured as wire-to-water energy efficiency at nominal rated intake pressure.
INJECT-PUMP-VLZ：According to the pump skid performance certification for Otay Valley Alluvial Terrace, the primary injection wellhead pump drive systems achieve a booster pump motor efficiency of 88 %, measured as wire-to-water energy efficiency at nominal rated intake pressure.
INJECT-PUMP-XU2：According to the pump skid performance certification for Sweetwater Coastal Basin, the primary injection wellhead pump drive systems achieve a booster pump motor efficiency of 92 %, measured as wire-to-water energy efficiency at nominal rated intake pressure.

information_points.title: Maintains high-pressure direct injection well intake capacities and manifold pressure ratings（WELL）
information_points.content:
INJECT-WELL-TSJ：For Otay Valley Alluvial Terrace, the candidate supplemental deep injection well cluster demonstrates a deep aquifer injection intake rate of 3,000 m3/d, measured as the total stable 24-hour pressurized injection flow accepted into the regional confined aquifer.
INJECT-WELL-9VY：For Tijuana River Floodplain Spreading Grounds, the candidate supplemental deep injection well cluster demonstrates a deep aquifer injection intake rate of 3,000 m3/d, measured as the total stable 24-hour pressurized injection flow accepted into the regional confined aquifer.
INJECT-WELL-O20：For Sweetwater Coastal Basin, the candidate supplemental deep injection well cluster demonstrates a deep aquifer injection intake rate of 4,000 m3/d, measured as the total stable 24-hour pressurized injection flow accepted into the regional confined aquifer.
